lines.text: Patients wait in long queues… then forget what matters.

lines.text: बीपी की गोली लेता हूँ, नाम याद नहीं।
lines.caption: BP ki goli leta hoon… naam yaad nahi.

lines.text: Meet Queue Saathi. While you wait, answer a few questions by voice.
lines.caption: Meet QueueSaathi. While you wait, answer a few questions by voice.

lines.text: Gnani’s Prisma listens. Every answer is checked, never guessed.
lines.caption: Gnani’s Prisma listens. Every answer is checked, never guessed.

lines.text: Something urgent? You’re told to alert reception right away.

lines.text: The doctor gets a clean summary, with the patient’s own words as evidence.
lines.caption: The doctor gets a clean summary, with the patient’s own words as evidence.

lines.text: In our tests, medicine name recognition accuracy improved from fifty two percent to ninety five percent.
lines.caption: In our tests, medicine-name recognition accuracy: 52% → 95%.
